intro: Orphan Matron Battlewail manages the Horde orphanage in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. Together with her fellow caretaker Tosamina, she shelters and raises young orc children who have lost their families to continuous warfare.

p: War takes a constant toll across Azeroth, and the young capital of Orgrimmar bears witness to those costs. Orphan Matron Battlewail tends to the youngsters who lost their kin to violence, ensuring that the next generation of the Horde is protected, sheltered, and nurtured. Working alongside Tosamina in the Valley of Honor, Battlewail opens the orphanage doors to passing adventurers, especially during festive traditions like Children's Week when travelers are called upon to mentor these youths.
